title: OSM Data Processing & QA Pipelines
description: A technical resource for building, maintaining, and scaling automated OpenStreetMap data pipelines — PBF/XML parsing, tag normalization, topology cleaning, routing graph extraction, update diff sync, validation rules, and Python automation.
author: OSM Data Processing

sections.title: OSM Data Fundamentals & Architecture
sections.blurb: Schema, serialization, spatial indexing, tag taxonomy, and licensing foundations for production-grade OSM pipelines.

sections.title: Parsing & Tag Normalization Workflows
sections.blurb: Async PBF parsing, parser selection, batch attribute mapping, regex-driven value cleaning, error handling, and routing-graph conversion.

sections.title: OSM Replication & Diff Sync
sections.blurb: Keep local extracts current with .osc.gz change files, replication sequence numbers, full-history .osh.pbf, and automated minutely update pipelines.

sections.title: OSM Data Quality & Validation
sections.blurb: Author JOSM, Osmose, and Python validation rules; repair geometry; check routing-graph topology and tag consistency across the pipeline.

sections.title: Querying OSM: Overpass, Nominatim & APIs
sections.blurb: Overpass QL, Nominatim geocoding, the editing API, extract providers, and deciding when a live query beats a local extract.

sections.title: OSM Vector Tiles & Rendering Pipelines
sections.blurb: Turn normalized OSM features into vector tiles: the MVT geometry model, Tippecanoe, Planetiler, PMTiles serving, and zoom-aware generalization.

sections.title: OSM Conflation & Data Enrichment
sections.blurb: Match OSM features against authoritative datasets, prepare imports, enrich attributes from external sources, and audit a conflation run before it ships.
